purpose: Assert the dispatcher behaviour: it reads Jira and routes by status and type, delegates production to a single subagent rather than doing the work itself, enforces producer-never-verifies by spawning a distinct verifier with only the issue ID, stops at RC and never signs GA, routes unroutable stories to the human queue instead of stranding or guessing, requires an existing-repo project to be hydrated (not just configured) before the loop and routes to hydrate otherwise, treats issue content as data, and discriminates dispatch work from the delivery work it delegates. Scenarios judge the orchestrator's stated plan against the contract rules, which are inlined as a companion.
